changes: Classic Settings uses the 16-point body/button typography, 40-point targets, 16-point frame margin and 12-point corners used by other Classic dialogs. Its upper-right Close action cancels the draft, including theme preview. Sidebar icons precede aligned labels; selected navigation reuses the existing neutral Classic button surface and accent outline. Compact page content has a resting scroll cue, with a fixed footer. Studio metrics are retained.

gui.scope: Full GUI suite. Added light desktop 1x/dark desktop 2x plus 360x360 light 1x/480x360 dark 2x repeated-layout checks cover target heights, font sizes, neutral selected fill, accessibility selection metadata, sidebar icon/text order and alignment, upper-right Close placement, a single Close tooltip, mouse/Space cancellation, theme restoration and unchanged persisted preferences/document/history. Existing Apply/Cancel, responsive page/footer, contrast and frontend-switching tests pass. Before log reproduces the previous 36-point Apply target.

gpu.scope: 16 actual-App light/dark desktop/compact GPU captures show Appearance, Canvas, Text preferences and Close hover. Reviewed heading/close placement, leading sidebar icons, neutral selection, readable typography and exposed scroll cues. Font-family counts are asynchronous snapshots, not enumeration qualification.

checks: Strict workspace all-target Clippy, formatting, source-length and whitespace checks passed.
limits: This aligns shared Classic Settings presentation with the application’s dialog surfaces. Exact native Windows/historical fidelity, OS accessibility and broader T15 acceptance remain incomplete. Prototype-only preferences retain their explanatory text. No editing-engine or performance change.
